newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firmer, fuel oil mixed.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firmer, fuel oil mixed.

text.p: Most NWE oil products gained on Friday but fuel oil was mixed.
Gasoline rebounded with NYMEX and good buying interest into the U.K. A eurograde barge traded late at $218 a tonne fob ARA.
Naphtha was firmer with strong bidding seen for a pipeline spec cargo and two offers at $232 a tonne cif NWE.
High sulphur fuel oil cargoes were stronger on a $117 fob NWE deal, but low sulphur was weaker on a $132 cif Italy deal.
Gas oil rose in line with a recovery in November IPE futures and higher premiums for diesel rose on perceptions of extremely tight supply. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8980
